basic_info.description: top floor beautifully remodeled Cole Valley Victorian Condo. Incredible natural light with windows on all side. Afternoon sun streams into the gorgeous eat-in kitchen lead to deck and garden outlooks. The whole unit stays light and bright throughout the day. Spacious,offering a flexible floor plan w/2+ BRs. Boutique 2 unit building.  Soaring ceilings, refinished floors, stunning molding, wall paneling, ceiling medallions & skylight. Recently remodeled (restored to its Victorian character over the decades), this home honors the past & is designed to the needs of contemporary living. Complete w/ upgraded finishes, light fixtures, surface lighting, new furnace, in-unit washer & dryer.  Formal dining room w/fireplace perfect for gathering. Excellent walk score.
